name: ironveil
label: Ironveil v1
notes: Static JS (fs/path only). utils/parse.js had eval() on text derived from the input (lines 7 and 9, exported as evalLuaNum, never called by the CLI = dead code, but exploitable if wired in: verified a harmless file write via crafted '(function() return require(...) end)()'). PATCHED: replaced by sEv() which only evals strings made of digits/arithmetic/comparison/boolean symbols. Bundled sample 123142 B -> 16768 B is byte-identical to the shipped expected deobfuscated.lua. Non-Ironveil input throws a bare Error (exit 1, noisy stack, fast).
